questions.text: What is the premium (Agio) per share if par value is EUR 2 and issue price is EUR 3?

options: Number of shares + par value per share

questions.correctAnswer: Number of shares × par value per share

questions.text: Which statement about issuing shares and par value is correct?
options: Issuing below par is allowed; the smallest par value is EUR 0.50.
Issuing below par is prohibited; the smallest par value is EUR 1.
Issuing below par is allowed; the smallest par value is EUR 10.
Issuing below par is prohibited; the smallest par value is EUR 2.
questions.correctAnswer: Issuing below par is prohibited; the smallest par value is EUR 1.
